declared_limits: SEALED CAPTURE REPLAY, not live pixels: these 202 frames are the certified offline walkfilm renders; the engine is NOT rendering anything here and the live panes are unaffected.
NOT interactive control and NOT the live engine: nothing on this page drives the monkey; no input path to the sealed W03 body exists.
NO new physics and zero engine work: a client-side image cycler over sha-pinned PNGs; no simulation, no re-render, no re-derive of pixel content.
Rigid rest pose only: no limb swing, no per-tick joints q[6..17]; the refusal-collapse tumble (ticks ~200-301) is NOT rendered - the upright body's certified planar base motion is shown instead.
Sampling is stride-3 (ticks 0..300, 101 ticks per shot, tick 301 excluded); two shots (track, approach) share the same tick set, 202 frames total.
In-image caption bars overlay the bottom 30 px of every frame (lane evidence convention).
PLAY/PAUSE/SCRUB ARE LOCAL UI CONTROLS over this frame playlist only; they never touch the engine and never change any mode - the goal never leaves play mode.
Frame file paths are bound to this campaign host; on any other host every frame refuses by name ('file missing') instead of serving anything.
The PNGs are the determinism unit; walkfilm_ffv1.mkv / walkfilm_preview.mp4 are convenience media and are NOT served by the viewer.
